user.description:
Select the configuration type for Blitzortung integration.

Data for this integration is served by a public MQTT server run specifically for this project. Keeping it online costs real money every month, so if you find the integration useful, please consider supporting the server upkeep at [buymeacoffee.com/emrk]({donate_url}).

data_description.config_type: The integration can be configured for static coordinates or follow the location entity.

data_description.location_entity: The `device_tracker`, `person` or `zone` entity whose location will be used by the integration.

data_description.name: The name the integration will use for this configuration.

error.entity_without_unique_id: The selected entity does not have a unique identifier, please use a different entity.
error.entity_without_coordinates: The selected entity does not provide coordinates.

abort.reconfigure_not_supported: For entity based config entry re-configuration is not supported.

data_description.radius: Radius of the circle for which lightnings will be detected.
data_description.time_window: Lifetime of tracked lightnings in minutes.
data_description.max_tracked_lightnings: Maximum number of tracked lightnings. Set to 0 to create no lightning strike entities (the sensors keep working).

mqtt_connect_not_ready.message: Failed to connect to Blitzortung MQTT server: {error}

init.description:
Large number of tracked lightnings ({tracked_lightnings}) may lead to bigger memory usage, unstable frontend or uncontrolled growth of the database.

Choose whether you want to reduce the number of tracked lightnings or ignore the issue. You can also change the number of tracked lightnings yourself in the config entry options.

confirm.description:
The configured lightning detection radius ({radius}) exceeds the maximum of {radius_max}. Data for this integration is served by a public MQTT server whose running costs grow with the area each user subscribes to. To keep the service sustainable, the maximum radius has been lowered to {radius_max}.

Submit to reduce the radius to {radius_max}, or change it yourself in the config entry options. This issue cannot be ignored and will come back after every restart until the radius is {radius_max} or less.

If you want to help cover the server costs, you can support the project at [buymeacoffee.com/emrk]({donate_url}).

init.description:
Large time window ({time_window}) may lead to bigger memory usage, unstable frontend or uncontrolled growth of the database.

Choose whether you want to reduce the time window or ignore this issue. You can also change the time window yourself in the config entry options.
